newsitem.title: JAPAN: Zexel to form China car parts venture.
newsitem.headline: Zexel to form China car parts venture.

text.p: Zexel Corp said on Thursday it will set up a joint venture in January in China's Hunan province for the production of compressors used in car air conditioners.

The joint venture, named Huada-Zexel Automotive Airconditioner Co Ltd, will be capitalised at about 1.30 billion yen and 55 percent owned by China's Hunan Huada Machinery Factory, 20 percent by Zexel, and the rest by three Japanese companies.
Hunan Huada Machinery Factory now produces compressors under the technical assistance of Zexel at an output rate of 70,000 to 80,000 units per year, a Zexel spokesman said.
The venture will use Hunan Huada Machinery Factory's existing facilities and a total of 3.30 billion yen will be invested to expand production facilities, he said.
The venture will start production in March 1997, the spokesman said. The new company expects to boost its compressor production to 300,000 units by the year 1999.
